Sample report: what your customers say

Fictional data: "Maison Verveine" is an imaginary hotel and shop; every review below was written for this example.

This sample was produced with the same simple keyword rules as the demo (callscope-ai 0.2.0), in French and English. The custovox.ai platform analyzes calls, reviews, tickets and emails in 5 languages.

Summary

12 reviews analyzed: 6 positive, 2 neutral, 4 negative. Most frequent topics: staff and welcome, cleanliness, product quality. 2 customer(s) say they will leave.
